# Governance Review

## Responsibilities

Generate:

- Architecture Decision Records (ADR)
- Autonomy Policies
- Evaluation Cases
- Results Tables
- Risk Audits
- Measurement Plans

## Rules

- Document assumptions.
- Document human validation.
- Include explicit decisions and rationale.
- Capture where AI assistance was incorrect, incomplete, or not useful.
- Capture final human decisions.
